what: The illustration mesh for the tetrapod frame, one GLB with one root per life-stage form. Built by sim-engine/scales/mesh/build_mesh.py from frames/tetrapod.py.
THIS_IS_NOT_MORPHOMETRY: This mesh is an ILLUSTRATION sculpted in Blender from textbook body plans. No shape, size, proportion or position in it was measured from any specimen; slot positions come from sim-engine/scales/body-frames.json, which are themselves declared. A stage form is a textbook schematic chosen by the stage name the design declares: nothing is interpolated between stages and development is not simulated. Never read a dimension off it.
axes: glTF Y-up, matching body-frames.json as the theatre draws it (world = pos * 2): +X anterior, +Y dorsal, +Z the organism's RIGHT, -Z its left. Stage size differences are NOT baked in; the page applies the declared length_ratio.

stages.label: juvenile, around weaning
stages.matched_by: keyword /juvenile|weanling/i on the declared label "juvenile, around weaning"

driver_notes: liftingArea_m2 is declared, but no body length is, so the area cannot be expressed in body lengths: the wing_membrane is drawn at schematic proportions, not sized by the declared area.

proportions: schematic, except where a node lists drivers_used (basis declared, with its source)
